harness_defect: Windows PowerShell Start-Process returned null ExitCode after WaitForExit; all 96 checks remain unqualified, regardless of their stdout.
harness_correction: Construct System.Diagnostics.Process directly and retain it through WaitForExit. Bounded host-only probes captured the expected exit codes 0 and 77.

kernel_failure.stderr: LinearSwiGLU FP8 correctness: cudaDeviceSynchronize: an illegal memory access was encountered
kernel_failure.cause: The ordinary-MMA schedule inherited 32 TMA producer threads; the collective SwiGLU epilogue subtracted the nonexistent producer warp from thread indices. The native adapter now explicitly uses zero producer threads.
